name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: keep pasted secrets out of the transcript, see what a session has in context, let a session drive itself toward a goal, switch MCP logins per project, equip a loadout of skills, MCP servers and instructions per project, call any API with keys kept out of the transcript, and design dashboards by Stephen Few's rules.

plugins.name: secret-keeper
plugins.description: Hides the secrets you paste before Claude or the transcript sees them, stores them per project in the macOS Keychain, and exports them to Bash as environment variables. Optional PII hiding.

plugins.name: context-compass
plugins.description: What a Claude Code session has in context: budget, files and how much of each was read, stale files, skills, helper agents, and what compaction summarised.

plugins.name: autopilot
plugins.description: Drives your Claude Code sessions on its own: asks you pointed questions first when a prompt leaves the goal, constraints or check unclear, rewrites a session's first prompt, decides permission asks from the whole conversation and Claude's questions once you've gone quiet, and after each turn sends the practical next step (fix, verify, commit on a branch) until only you can decide what is left, the push and the PR included.

plugins.name: mcp-accounts
plugins.description: Several logins for any OAuth MCP server (Slack workspaces, Supabase accounts, anything else by URL), each signed in once, with the active one picked per project by /account and the others blocked. Switching never needs a restart.

plugins.name: loadouts
plugins.description: Requip for Claude Code: named loadouts of skills, MCP servers and instructions, one equipped per project from the /loadout picker or by Claude itself, the rest switched off. Switching never needs a restart.

plugins.name: mcp-gateway
plugins.description: One MCP server for any REST API or remote MCP server: Claude names an alias from your config and the gateway calls it with that alias's API key, token or headers, switching mid-session with no reload. Keys stay in the config, never in the transcript.

plugins.name: information-dashboard-design
plugins.description: A skill that designs and critiques dashboards by Stephen Few's Information Dashboard Design: what belongs on a single glanceable screen, bullet graphs and sparklines over gauges and pies, layout, color and highlighting, the thirteen common mistakes, and Few's own palette and drawing specs taken from the book's figures.

plugins.name: supabase-flatten
plugins.description: A skill for Supabase projects in development: flattens supabase/migrations/ into a supabase/schemas/ tree exported by pg-delta, applies edits to it straight to the dev database with no migration files, resets the database to the latest schema plus seed, and writes one baseline migration when the project goes live.
